from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import os, subprocess, re, glob
smi='O=CC1CC=CC(=O)O1'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, randomSeed=17)
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m)
conf=m.GetConformer()
xyz=f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\n{smi}\n'
for i,a in enumerate(m.GetAtoms()):
 p=conf.GetAtomPosition(i); xyz+=f'{a.GetSymbol():2s} {p.x: .8f} {p.y: .8f} {p.z: .8f}\n'
open('mol.xyz','w').write(xyz)
inp='''! B3LYP def2-SVP TightSCF Opt Freq\n%pal nprocs 2 end\n* xyzfile 0 1 mol.xyz\n'''
open('mol.inp','w').write(inp)
print('Running ORCA...')
r=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/orca','mol.inp'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,timeout=600)
open('mol.out','w').write(r.stdout)
print('Return code:',r.returncode,'Output chars:',len(r.stdout))
lines=r.stdout.splitlines()
for i,line in enumerate(lines):
 if 'ORBITAL ENERGIES' in line:
  print('\n'.join(lines[i:i+12]))
print('Final energy lines:')
for line in lines:
 if 'FINAL SINGLE POINT ENERGY' in line or 'HOMO' in line and 'LUMO' in line: print(line)
print('Files:',glob.glob('mol*'))

import numpy as np, re
from pyscf import gto, dft
xyz=open('mol.xyz').read().splitlines()[2:]
atom=[]
for line in xyz:
 p=line.split(); atom.append((p[0], tuple(map(float,p[1:4]))))
mol=gto.M(atom=atom, basis='def2-svp', charge=0, spin=0, unit='Angstrom', verbose=0)
print('Atoms:', mol.natm, 'Electrons:', mol.nelectron)
mf=dft.RKS(mol)
mf.xc='b3lyp'
mf.conv_tol=1e-9
mf.max_cycle=100
energy=mf.kernel()
print('Converged:', mf.converged)
mo=mf.mo_energy
occ=mf.mo_occ
homo=mo[np.where(occ>0)[0][-1]]
lumo=mo[np.where(occ==0)[0][0]]
print('Total energy (Eh):', f'{energy:.12f}')
print('HOMO (Eh):', f'{homo:.12f}')
print('LUMO (Eh):', f'{lumo:.12f}')
print('Gap (Eh):', f'{lumo-homo:.12f}')
print('Gap (eV, reference only):', f'{(lumo-homo)*27.211386245988:.6f}')
